journal_lines: Tall thing in the dark. Careful not to look directly.
Purple eyes in the dark. Pearl for it.
Looked by accident. Fixed the situation quickly.
The rain drove it off. Waited for the rain.
Three of them in the clearing. Navigated with eyes down.
Block in its hands. Dropped it when challenged.
It was tall enough to duck the ceiling. I wasn't. Adjusted.
The clicking was almost musical. Not pleasant.
Made eye contact. Both of us waited. I moved first.
It screamed. Endermen do that. Ignored the noise.
Moving through enderman territory with great care about sight lines.
The pearl was worth it. The interaction was not.
Tall shadow. Moved deliberately around it.
